SELECT 
  "ID_Article" AS value,
  "Recherche_Article" AS label
FROM public."ARTICLES"
WHERE 
  "Statut_Ligne" = 'Actif'
  AND (
    {{ !sel_article.filterText }} 
    OR "Recherche_Article" ILIKE {{ '%' + sel_article.filterText + '%' }}
  )
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN "ID_Article" = {{ appsmith.store.nouvel_article_id || '' }} THEN 0 
    ELSE 1 
  END,
  "Recherche_Article" ASC
LIMIT 50;
